patterns: APPSC asks one-line founder/exponent attributions: Kumarila Bhatta = Purva Mimamsa (G2 2012, 2019), Shankaracharya = Advaita (G1), Uttara Mimamsa exponent (G1).
Odd-one-out on the six darshanas (Smriti, Lokayata/Kapalika as distractors) and 'oldest darshana = Samkhya' recur.
Doctrine-school matching (atomism - Vaisheshika, Satkaryavada - Samkhya, Apurva - Mimamsa, Syadvada - Jaina) is the main shape in other PSCs.
Rigvedic items: 9th mandala = Soma, Aditi vs Prithvi (APPSC G1 2022), Katha Upanishad (Nachiketa-Yama), 16 sanskaras.
App MCQs mirror these closely; extras are Ashtanga limb ordering, ritual-priest pairs and AP angles (Ikshvaku Santamula, Gudimallam), all at reasonable depth.
